_notes_a_verifier.starting_price: Free plan at $0 (1 user, 5 sites, 30-day history); Paid plans from $20/month (100k pageviews, 1 user included, +$20/month per additional user, monthly or annual billing with 2 months free; VAT treatment not stated on the pricing page — [À VÉRIFIER sur https://www.simpleanalytics.com/pricing])

tools.name: Simple Analytics
tools.cookies_by_default: No (Never sets cookies, localStorage, or sessionStorage according to vendor documentation)
tools.ip_handling: Not collected or stored; IP addresses are dropped on every request and replaced with zeros (0.0.0.0) via mmanon in error logs (per vendor docs)
tools.server_region: European Union (Netherlands via Worldstream and Leaseweb Dutch servers; Bunny CDN via BunnyWay in Slovenia, EU)
tools.data_retention: 30 days on the Free plan (older data auto-deleted); on paid plans, encrypted data is retained per subscription tier while account is active and permanently deleted 90 days after account deletion (per vendor docs)
tools.best_for: SaaS & E-commerce teams seeking lightweight EU-hosted cookieless telemetry
tools.vendor_claim_summary: According to Simple Analytics' official documentation, the script measures pageviews, events, and time-zone country without setting cookies, fingerprinting devices, or storing IP addresses.

tools.name: Plausible Analytics
tools.cookies_by_default: No (No cookies, browser cache, or localStorage used according to vendor documentation)
tools.ip_handling: Transiently processed with User-Agent, domain, and a daily rotating salt (hash(daily_salt + website_domain + ip_address + user_agent)); raw IP is never written to disk or logs (per vendor docs)
tools.server_region: European Union (Hetzner servers in Falkenstein, Germany; UpCloud in Finland for databases/exports; Bunny CDN in Slovenia)
tools.data_retention: No retention limit on Starter, Growth, and Business plans until user deletes site or account; daily cryptographic salt is rotated and deleted every 24 hours; encrypted backups kept for 30 days (per vendor docs)
tools.hosting_options: Managed EU Cloud or Self-Hosted (Docker / AGPLv3 Community Edition)
tools.starting_price: Starter plan at $9/month (USD, up to 10k monthly pageviews, monthly or annual billing with 2 months free; VAT excluded and calculated at checkout by Paddle, verified 2026-11-09)
tools.best_for: Developers wanting open-source transparency or custom event tracking
tools.vendor_claim_summary: According to Plausible Analytics' official data policy and EU hosting documentation, visitor uniqueness is estimated via a 24-hour salted hash without cookies, and all data stays on European-owned servers.

_notes_a_verifier.data_retention: Daily salt rotates at midnight UTC, but SHA-256 visitor signatures of past events remain stored in the database after midnight UTC and no maximum purge period for aggregate stats is specified in /data — [À VÉRIFIER sur https://usefathom.com/data]
_notes_a_verifier.starting_price: From $15/month (USD, up to 100,000 monthly pageviews and up to 50 sites included, monthly or annual billing with 2 months free; VAT treatment not stated on the pricing page — [À VÉRIFIER sur https://usefathom.com/pricing])

tools.name: Fathom Analytics
tools.cookies_by_default: No (No tracking cookies used according to vendor documentation)
tools.ip_handling: Combined with User-Agent, site ID, and a daily salt (rotating at midnight UTC) to create a SHA-256 visitor signature; EU visitor IPs are stripped on EU servers before forwarding, while detected bot records store raw IPs (per vendor docs)
tools.server_region: EU Data Isolation proxy servers in Germany (Falkenstein, Nuremberg) and Finland (Helsinki) for EU/EEA/UK/CH initial anonymization; Bunny.net CDN; main analytics database storage on US infrastructure (per vendor docs)
tools.hosting_options: Managed Cloud with EU Data Isolation (or Extreme EU Isolation via cdn-eu.usefathom.com)
tools.best_for: Agencies and content sites needing built-in uptime checks and EU routing
tools.vendor_claim_summary: According to Fathom Analytics' technical data documentation, EU traffic is anonymized on European servers before anonymized event records and SHA-256 visitor signatures are stored on US infrastructure.

_notes_a_verifier.starting_price: Business plan from €36/month (EUR, up to 2M monthly actions and 20 domains); Enterprise from $25,000/year; Healthcare Enterprise from $30,000/year (VAT treatment not stated on the pricing page — [À VÉRIFIER sur https://piwik.pro/business-plan/ et https://piwik.pro/pricing/])

tools.name: Piwik PRO Analytics Suite
tools.cookies_by_default: Configurable (First-party visitor cookies enabled by default; can be disabled or set to 30-minute cookies, 30-minute session hashes, or strict cookieless mode per vendor docs)
tools.ip_handling: Configurable IP masking in Administration > Privacy removes 1, 2, or 3 bytes from the visitor IP address prior to database storage (per vendor docs)
tools.server_region: 60+ locations including Azure Cloud (Germany, Netherlands, United States, Hong Kong) and Elastx servers (Sweden) across Public or Private Cloud (per vendor docs)
tools.data_retention: 25 months on the Business plan; 25+ months on Enterprise and Healthcare Enterprise plans (per vendor docs)
tools.hosting_options: Managed Public Cloud or Enterprise Private Cloud (Dedicated Database or Dedicated Hardware)
tools.best_for: Large enterprises and healthcare/government teams requiring integrated Consent Management (CMP)
tools.vendor_claim_summary: According to Piwik PRO's privacy documentation, the suite pairs web analytics with a built-in consent manager, configurable IP byte masking, and optional 30-minute session hashes.

_notes_a_verifier.starting_price: Matomo On-Premise Community is Free (€0 forever; Team bundle from €275/month or €230/month billed annually); Matomo Cloud Business displays two different entry amounts on matomo.org/pricing/ depending on currency/table (USD 26/month excl. tax vs EUR 29/month excl. tax for 50,000 monthly hits, annual billing gives 2 months free — [À VÉRIFIER sur https://matomo.org/pricing/])

tools.name: Matomo Analytics
tools.cookies_by_default: Configurable (First-party cookies enabled by default with a 13-month cap in CNIL mode; cookieless tracking and opt-out supported per vendor docs)
tools.ip_handling: In-memory IP anonymization enabled by default (2 bytes masked by default); configurable to mask 1, 2, 3, or all 4 bytes (0.0.0.0) for IPv4/IPv6 before database storage (per vendor docs)
tools.server_region: European Union (Frankfurt, Germany for Matomo Cloud) or User-Controlled On-Premise server location (per vendor docs)
tools.data_retention: Matomo Cloud Business retains raw visit logs for up to 24 months (capped at 759 days in CNIL compliance mode) and aggregated reports forever; Matomo On-Premise retention is fully configurable by the administrator (per vendor docs)
tools.hosting_options: Managed EU Cloud or Self-Hosted On-Premise (PHP/MySQL)
tools.best_for: Organizations needing full raw log ownership on their own MySQL servers
tools.vendor_claim_summary: According to Matomo's official documentation, administrators can enforce CNIL consent-exemption settings, disable cookies, and mask IP addresses in memory before storage.

_notes_a_verifier.starting_price: GA4 Standard is Free ($0); Google Analytics 360 enterprise tier is available by custom contract quote only without public pricing in official Google documentation — [À VÉRIFIER sur https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/10000067]

tools.name: Google Analytics 4 (GA4)
tools.cookies_by_default: Yes (Writes first-party _ga cookies when consent is granted; sends cookieless pings when consent is denied in Advanced Consent Mode per Google docs)
tools.ip_handling: According to Google documentation, individual IP addresses are not logged or stored; for EU, UK, and Switzerland traffic, IPs are used on regional servers solely for coarse geolocation lookup and immediately deleted before logging
tools.server_region: Regional EU, UK, and Switzerland collection domains and servers for initial IP lookup and collection, followed by traffic transfer to Google Analytics processing servers (per Google docs)
tools.data_retention: 2 months or 14 months for user-level and event-level data in GA4 Standard (26, 38, or 50 months in GA360; capped at 2 months for Large/XL properties and demographic data); applies to Explorations and Funnel reports only (per Google docs)
tools.best_for: Marketing teams heavily reliant on Google Ads bidding and complex consent banners
tools.vendor_claim_summary: According to Google's official documentation, GA4 collects EU visitor traffic through regional EU servers to discard IP addresses before processing and relies on Consent Mode signals in the EEA.
